simple.meaning: פָּרַק (pâraq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to break off or crunch ; figuratively, to deliver.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 10 times across Genesis, Exodus, 1 Kings, Psalms, Lamentations, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 27:40. Its contexts include family, family line, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּרַק (H6561).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פָּרַק (pâraq) / H6561 is traced through Genesis 27:40, Exodus 32:2, Exodus 32:3, Exodus 32:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother.
Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
He said, “Go out, and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.”
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this,
and has delivered us from our adversaries;
But it was plucked up in fury.

For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

definitions.short: to break off or crunch ; figuratively, to deliver
definitions.usage: break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.
definitions.full: H6561. paraq [ מָּרַק ] verb tear apart, away (Late Hebrew remove (load, etc.), Pi`el separate, take to pieces ; Arabic split, divide ;; מְּרַק ᵑ7 especially redeem, rescue ; Syriac withdraw (intransitive), also remove, rescue ; Ethiopic : set free ); — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular וּפָרַקְדָמתּ֫ Gen 27:40 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix וַיִּפְרְקֵנזּ Psa 136:24 ; Participle active מֹּרֵק Lam 5:8 ; Psa 7:3 tear away yoke from pff ( מֵעַל neck Gen 27:40 (J); snatck from ( מִן ) foes, = rescue (Aramaic) Lam 5:8 ; Psa 136:24 ; so absolute 7:3 (prefixing ᵑ6 ᵑ7 (וְ)אֵין, Che Du We), > Hup Bae and others snatch away as prey. Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפָרֵק Zech 11:16 he shall tear off their hoofs; Imperative masculine plural מָּֽרְקוּ Exod 32:2 (E) tear off the golden ear-tings; Participle מְפָרֵק 1Kin 19:11 a great wind rending mountains (|| מְשַׁבֵּר ). Hithpa`el tear off (for, i.e. from, oneself Ges § 54f ); Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיִּתְמָּֽרְקוּ Exod 32:3 (E), with accusative הַזָּהָב אֶתנִֿזְמֵי ; Imperative masculine plural הִתְמָּרָ֑קוּ 32:24 (E; object omitted); passive be broken off, Perfect 3plural הִתְמָּֽרְקוּ Ezek 19:12 (branches).
